mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, c1.C_Name_History as pConstructionUnitNameHistory, c2.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, c1.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, d1.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c2.C_Name as cName, d2.D_Name as dName, c1.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, mn.* from OA_Notice mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_ID=mn.P_ID left join SYS_Company c1 on pro.P_Construction_Unit=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Department d1 on pro.P_Competent_Department=d1.D_Id left join SYS_Department d2 on mn.D_Id=d2.D_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.C_Id=c2.C_Id where mn.N_Id=#{nId}
